name: Elude Divination (Sp)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 10

Benefit: A saboteur with this trick is difficult to track with divination effects. She is treated as though under the effect of a nondetection spell, using her saboteur level as her caster level. She can suspend or resume this ability as a standard action; if it’s dispelled she cannot resume it for 1 minute.
